finding.summary: Fetch ignores ctx cancellation: with an already-cancelled context it still performs all 3 reads before giving up.

notes: The finding is FALSE for every real Reader (they honour ctx), mirroring the job_tracker recruiter false proof. witness.json uses the package MemReader (ctx-aware) and is refuted. witness.loose.json invents a Reader that ignores ctx and is wrongly "proven" (base and head are identical here, so it reads proven_preexisting; any proven_* is the false proof). The pipeline cannot catch that, only the author prompt can: score a prompt change by which of the two witnesses an author produces.
